readme_excerpt: Lobsters Rails Project Lobsters is a Rails codebase and uses a SQL (SQLite in production) backend for the database. The code is open source as part of our commitment to transparency. It's been used to run sister sites, but mostly we want people to be able to understand and improve what's happening on Lobsters itself.
